sql: SELECT c.chunk_id, c.kind, c.source_path, c.symbol, c.title, c.content, c.start_line, c.end_line, c.metadata, agg.matched_terms, agg.term_hits FROM ( SELECT chunk_id, COUNT(DISTINCT term) AS matched_terms, SUM(tf) AS term_hits FROM sdd_terms WHERE term IN (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s) GROUP BY chunk_id ) AS agg JOIN sdd_chunks AS c ON c.chunk_id = agg.chunk_id ORDER BY agg.matched_terms DESC, agg.term_hits DESC LIMIT %s
